description: A gentle Machinarium-style mechanical hedgehog companion standing on an old wooden skateboard, holding a small rust-red booklet and carrying a tiny white flower at its side.

idle.notes: Quiet skateboard idle with tiny breathing and blink while the booklet and flower stay stable.

walk.notes: Directional skateboard glide rows used for right and left movement.

curious.notes: Small focused look toward the rust-red booklet with a gentle head tilt.

happy.notes: Restrained pleased uplift with a tiny arm motion while keeping the booklet stable.

sleep.notes: Soft drowsy resting loop on the skateboard with booklet and flower still present.

active.notes: Support loop for a quietly busy, attentive working posture.

hop.notes: Very small unified board-bounce hop used as a support motion.

melancholy.notes: Low-energy tired or disappointed posture without detached effects.

drag.notes: Directional drag reuses the true left-facing and right-facing skateboard glide rows.

dragFacingValidation.rule: deltaX < 0 => facing left; deltaX > 0 => facing right
manualVerification: left drag uses the true left-facing skateboard glide row
right drag uses the true right-facing skateboard glide row
walk_left and walk_right are not swapped
snout, eye, booklet, body, skateboard deck, and wheel direction agree with travel direction
Thorn remains readable at small size as a mechanical hedgehog with skateboard, booklet, and flower
